info.name: api-onboarding Account Usage Withdrawal Accounts API

params.name: account_id
params.description: The UUID of a sub-account you want to see the withdrawal accounts for. If omitted the withdrawal accounts for the house account and all sub-accounts are returned.

items.docs: Lists all withdrawal accounts assigned to an account.

params.name: withdrawal_account_id
params.description: The withdrawal account ID you want to pull the funds from. The funds will be pulled into the account ID related to this withdrawal account.

items.docs: Submits an ACH pull request from a specific withdrawal account. The funds will be pulled into the account the specified withdrawal account is related to.
